summary: A tracked main battle tank with a long-barrelled gun. It is built to win tank duels and hold the line against armour, but it needs support against massed soldiers and anti-tank teams.

sections.title: Main gun
sections.how: Select the Type 99A and left-click an enemy, or let it fire at anything in range.
sections.body: The long gun fires one armour-piercing shell at a time. It is made for tank duels and punches through light vehicles, but the shell does little against infantry, and the gun cannot fire at aircraft.

sections.title: Composite armour
sections.how: Buy Composite armour at your vehicle factory.
sections.body: Add-on composite and ceramic plates raise the health of the Type 99A, the ZBL-09 and the Mengshi.

sections.title: Repair at the vehicle factory
sections.how: Select the damaged Type 99A and press Repair at factory, or left-click your vehicle factory.
sections.body: The Type 99A drives to the factory and is repaired for half its price, paid as the health comes back.

tips: Pair it with a ZBL-09 or riflemen: the tank fights armour while they clear the enemy infantry around it.
Do not drive it alone into a crowd of soldiers; infantry and anti-tank teams close in on it.
Pull damaged Type 99As back to the vehicle factory; repairs cost half the price.
